definitions.attempt_exclusions: excludes pre-attempt DB queue and client upload/admission; DB acceptance timestamp excludes later commit/HTTP ack and post-acceptance duplicate report retry delays
definitions.classes: actual prompt_tokens / requested output cap >=16 prefill_heavy, <=4 decode_heavy, otherwise balanced
definitions.cost_proxy: sum(recorded predicted_service_seconds * profile hourly_cost_usd /3600), where hourly_cost_usd=16.10/16; ranking proxy, not observed billing
definitions.db_created_to_finished_seconds: task.finished_at - batch.created_at; includes pre-claim DB queue and post-claim work
definitions.diagnostic_actual_input_service_seconds: actual prompt_tokens / unchanged profile_prefill_rate + unchanged requested_output_cap/profile_decode_rate; arithmetic sensitivity only, not fitted calibration
definitions.first_queue_seconds: min(attempt.started_at) - batch.created_at; for these one-attempt tasks, excludes later worker/KV/engine queues
definitions.input_estimate: ceil(compact UTF8 JSON(messages) bytes /4), not tokenizer count or KV reservation
definitions.input_estimated_over_actual_ratio: estimated_input_tokens / accepted task prompt_tokens; >1 means overestimate
definitions.observed_attempt_over_predicted_service_: observed DB attempt duration / recorded predicted service seconds; >1 means longer observed attempt, not isolated GPU slowdown
definitions.observed_attempt_price_proxy: sum(DB attempt duration) * unchanged projected slot-hour price /3600; overlapping claims/KV waits make this a diagnostic arithmetic proxy, not allocated GPU-hours
definitions.observed_attempt_scope: claim transaction/dispatch, worker engine availability, exact-tokenizer call, KV reservation wait, engine queue/computation/response validation, and completion report path through its accepted SQL update before COMMIT/ACK; phase durations unavailable
definitions.observed_attempt_seconds: attempt.finished_at - attempt.started_at (DB timestamps); attempt started_at defaults to transaction-start now(), not worker/engine start
definitions.percentiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, rounded6 decimals; rows are repeated tasks within one cohort, not independent experiment replications
definitions.predicted_prefill_component_shift_from_h: recorded prefill prediction minus diagnostic prefill using actual prompt count; positive means token heuristic makes prediction longer
definitions.service_signed_percentage_error: 100 * (predicted - observed DB attempt) / observed DB attempt
definitions.timing_join_residual_seconds: task completion - first queue - observed attempt; small signed negative residual is preserved because task and attempt finish timestamps are separate SQL clock calls
definitions.whole_pod_allocation: cohort client-observed wall * assumed 16.10 USD/hour; excludes output validation and gaps outside cohort wall; not invoice or marginal cost

limitations: Three serial descriptive cohorts, N=1 each, different workloads/batch counts/start times; no randomized A/B or confidence intervals
All 300 tasks are fixed length-capped completions, not natural-EOS or answer-quality evaluation
Attempt intervals contain unmeasured claim/dispatch, tokenization, reservation, engine queue and report portions; no stage latency or isolated per-stream prefill/decode rate is identified
Task repeats share one engine and continuous batching; within-cell quantiles are correlated descriptive observations; mixed 20-cell n=5 tails are especially weak
Only one four-H100 TP4 runtime; no heterogeneous-hardware cross-validation, transfer calibration or fleet-scale claim
Accepted successful single-attempt tasks only; no failed/retried/uncertain execution cost population is present
No live DB/HTTP/GPU read and no profile, price, rate or scheduler policy was modified
Aggregate cohort token throughput is never substituted for per-stream scheduling profile rates
The static16-derived rates remain explicitly projected and uncalibrated for adaptive64; claim concurrency 64 does not create 64 priced execution slots

binding: model repository+revision+quantization, tokenizer/chat-template hashes and max context
GPU model/count/memory, TP/PP topology, CPU/driver/CUDA/vLLM versions and collective configuration
engine flags including eager/graph/capture sizes, prefix cache/chunked prefill, max seqs/batched tokens and physical KV capacity
worker shared KV budget/block size/claim cap, profile source and raw stage-instrumentation version
explicit price scope whole-Pod allocation versus marginal provider price; no implicit division by claim capacity
cost_validation: score whole-Pod allocation with measured occupied wall and all rejected/retried/idle work; report utilization/occupancy independently
test proxy ranking against actual hardware-window allocation across queues and workloads; proxy/allocation ratios are diagnostics, not invoices
preserve published projected-static16 defaults until independently reviewed holdout measurements justify a new versioned profile
experimental_matrix: separate workload cells across prompt 128/512/2048/8192/16384 and output 32/128/512/2048, plus natural-EOS multilingual/structured/long-tail holdouts
stratify measured admitted execution by real active-stream bins 1/2/4/8/16/32/64 when feasible, offered load and KV pressure; distinguish 64 claims from 64 executing streams
cold/warm prefix-cache and eager/graph settings as separate runtime bindings; never mix into one profile
repeat independent serial cohorts, randomize workload/config order and block by time; keep task/profile/runtime hashes fixed
repeat the same contract on each actual hardware/topology class before enabling heterogeneous cost routing
fit_and_validation: use stage-specific service estimates conditional on actual tokens, output behavior, concurrency and KV pressure; model reservation/queue separately
split training/validation/holdout by run/time and prompt-template family so repeated fixture rows cannot leak across splits
report signed bias, MAE, percentage error, observed/predicted factors and P50/P95/P99 residuals per cell/class/concurrency, with independent-run uncertainty
choose numeric error/coverage and routing-regret acceptance thresholds before collecting holdout; publish full failed/retried cost scope
validate ranking and deadline behavior in a shadow scheduler against the unchanged projected baseline before any production promotion
keep compatibility/runtime fingerprint separate from hardware calibration identity; require expiry/drift monitoring, explicit promotion and exact rollback
proposed_release_gates: Planning targets, not achieved results: per hardware/runtime stratum start with 3 independent training runs, 1 validation run and 3 untouched holdout runs; preserve time/prompt-family splits
Cover at least 30 heldout tasks per populated workload-cell/concurrency bin spread across 3 holdout runs; leave uncovered bins projected rather than extrapolating calibrated status

Proposed heldout service gates per supported class/concurrency stratum: median absolute percentage error<=25%, P95 absolute percentage error<=60%, median signed percentage bias within plus/minus 15%; evaluate engine-service and reservation/queue predictors separately
A nominal 90% prediction interval should have heldout empirical coverage 85% to 95% in supported strata; report independent-run uncertainty and withhold promotion if evidence is insufficient
Exact-tokenizer accounting must match accepted prompt usage; any fallback UTF8 heuristic remains explicitly tagged and must not reserve KV or impersonate exact tokens

Shadow-routing promotion also requires predeclared deadline/fairness nonregression and measured hardware-window cost/ranking utility; a service-error pass alone cannot establish cheaper heterogeneous routing
telemetry: durable custom-id/attempt-number linkage with safe metadata only; no prompt/response bodies or credentials
separate pre-claim DB queue, claim transaction+dispatch, worker receipt/tokenize, KV reservation wait, engine request/response, report-send/durable-accept/ack timers
worker monotonic durations and bounded trace IDs; preserve DB timestamps separately instead of treating distributed clocks as identical
engine queue/prefill/TTFT/decode stage evidence if instrumented; full-response wall alone must not be labeled TTFT or kernel time
concurrent active streams/engine queue/KV used+reserved and workload mix over each interval; explicit sampling coverage/gaps
actual tokenizer prompt count, requested output cap, actual generated count, status/retries/rejected work and accepted usage
